He accidentally spills the white liquid onto the floor and his foot, which is covered by a light blue sock with green alien patterns. (2) The camera zooms in on the floor where the spilled milk puddles. The man's foot, clad in the patterned blue sock, steps into the milk, spreading it further across the light-colored tiled surface. (3) The man looks directly at the camera with wide eyes and an open mouth, expressing shock. He is still holding the milk carton and the small bowl while standing in the kitchen area. (4) A woman with long straight black hair, wearing dark sunglasses and a light blue crop top with grey sweatpants, stands stoically in front of a transparent shoe display case. (5) Back in the kitchen, the man hurriedly places the milk carton on the counter and glances around furtively, seemingly worried about the mess he made. (6) A montage begins with rapid cuts. A hand enters the frame and lifts the woman's sunglasses. The man is shown holding paper currency towards her. The woman responds with a neutral look or a wink. (7) The man is shown smiling happily at the camera, then he turns his head to the side and exits the frame.
